title: PaperOS DTCG token file
description: A W3C Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) format token file, restricted to the token types this build understands (see packages/tokens/docs/platform/design-tokens.md). Every object is either a *group* (nests further groups/tokens, may carry $description) or a *token* (carries $type and $value, may carry $description). Group and token keys must be lower-kebab-case or a bare number, so a token path maps cleanly onto a CSS custom property name.
